senses.gloss: वह् vah (only —˚, stg. base vāh, wk. uh or ūh, 🞄which coalesces with a preceding a to au), 🞄drawing, conveying, bearing, holding etc..

वाह् VĀH, Ⅰ. Ā. vāha (rare), press. pra, 🞄id.;
 cs. -vāhaya, P. id.. saṃ-pra, id..
वाह् 1. vā́h, only -e, d. inf. (of √ vāh = 🞄√ vah) for drawing (RV.¹).
वाह् 2. vāh, strg. base of vah (—˚).
वहंलिह vaha-ṃ-liha, a. licking the shoulder.
वहध्यै váha-dhyai, V. inf. (√ vah) to ride.

वहनीकृ vahan-ī-kṛ, turn into a vehicle;
 🞄-īya, fp. to be carried, drawn, or conducted.
वहराविन् vaha-rāvin, a. groaning under 🞄the yoke.
वहल vaha-lá, a. accustomed to the yoke, 🞄broken in.
वह्य vah-yá, n. portable bed, litter, palanquin, 🞄couch (V.).
वह्येशया vahye-śayā́, a. f. lying on a litter 🞄or couch (RV.¹).
वाहिष्ठ vāh-iṣṭha, spv. (= váhiṣṭha) wafting 🞄or bringing most (RV.).
